fitted.said: On the prints that just finished, the fit turned out wonderful. Best faucet display cover fit so far, and very tight/firm. It is good enough. You can see in the photos it is not perfect though. ... on the aft side it is almost like that, but still a bit of a ramp where you can see the tip kissing the surface. But on the fore side, as we bring the camera around the side you see we do make quite a lot of contact with the surface there for a bit, and then we get gaps again.
fitted.tried: the printed cover snapped onto the printed Sculpted tip

fitted.said: Regarding the faucet tip and faucet display cover, that is the best fit that we've had of anything ever. It's amazing. I love it. I think the only tiny imperfection is a hole you can see, which isn't even a gap between the display cover and the faucet tip, even though it might look like a gap between them. It's not. It's actually like a hole in the faucet tip that just didn't get quite covered by the display cover. And other than that, I mean, I think it looks pretty damn good.
fitted.tried: the printed cover snapped onto the printed tip from the same plate
